paper_title: First Result for Dark Matter Search by WINERED
notes: Indirect detection of decaying ALP dark matter (mass 1.8-2.7 eV) into two photons using WINERED spectrograph on dSphs Leo V and Tucana II. Primary decay-rate limit q*Gamma_phi translated to g_phi_gamma_gamma for ALP (q=2). Text states conservative bound g ~ (2-3)e-11 GeV^-1 for NFW profile, ~1e-10 GeV^-1 for generalized Hernquist. Data points approximate the NFW main-result band (bottom panel Fig.1, after spline continuous-spectrum subtraction) which ranges ~1e-12 to 5e-11 across mass.
